proposed.explanation: Postmodernism shows meaning matters; ornament communicates meaning. Postmodernism does not establish superiority of historical styles; it acknowledges their communicative value. Postmodern ornament carries meaning; it is not merely decorative. Postmodernism demonstrated that buildings can communicate cultural meaning through ornament and historical reference—challenging modernism's claim that universal principles transcend meaning.
